wholePhysicalScope: Surviving mapped palace way 183852572 fixes a roughly 55 m by 21 m principal footprint and projection. The wider historic stair geometry is estimated.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the roof pavilions, Doric entry, double stairs, fountain and mapped envelope. Near levels add deep reveals, stair balusters, roof seams and carved cornice trims.
limitations: Circa 1819 exterior is reconstructed from prints and surviving walls. Individual bay details, elevation, roof structure, finishes and stair grades are estimates.
The original ground samples are preserved. Historic landscaping, annexes, the chapel, interiors and furnishings are outside the main residence model. The stair and footing grade are approximate.
